caption: The drawing contains two objects centered on a plain, off-white background. The upper object is a handheld tool with a brown, wedge-shaped base that tapers to a rounded point, a raised black handle, and metallic gray elements along its top and side edges. The lower object is a bundle of wooden matches, tan to brown in color, arranged parallel to each other with red match heads aligned at one end. The composition is simple, with both objects depicted in realistic colors and moderate detail. The artist's signature and identification text appear in small, red script near the bottom right corner of the drawing within a light rectangular border.
title: Slipper Match Box
